results.title: Ferdinandus Aming Santoso Sells Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara
results.body: On September 16, 2026, insider Ferdinandus Aming Santoso sold 96,998,000 Sarana Menara Nusantara shares at IDR 437 per share, amounting to IDR 42,388,126,000 and cutting his ownership from 0.185% to 0.021%. The divestment follows a wave of insider sales on September 18, 2026, where three other insiders collectively disposed of more than 55 million shares at the same price, indicating a broader reduction of insider holdings.

results.title: Ario Wibisono Sell Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara
results.body: Insider Ario Wibisono sold 7,861,000 Sarana Menara Nusantara shares at IDR 437 per share on 2026-09-16, generating proceeds of IDR 3,435,257,000. The sale reduced his holding from 249,516,800 to 241,655,800 shares, lowering his ownership from 0.422% to 0.409% of the company. The transaction was disclosed as a divestment.

results.title: PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) Acquires Remaining Shares of PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE), Achieving Full Ownership
results.body: PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) completed the purchase of the remaining shares of its subsidiary PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE), raising its ownership to 100% (10.5 trillion shares) after buying 1.44 million series A and 2.01 trillion series B shares (19.19% of TDE) from Telkomsigma. TLKM said the transaction has no material impact on its finances, reaffirmed its 2026 EBITDA‑margin target above 50% (Q1 margin 49.4% and Q2 already above target), and reported first‑half 2026 revenue of Rp75.9 trillion (up 3.9% YoY) driven by Telkomsel’s 3.3% revenue growth to Rp55.6 trillion and an EBITDA margin rise to 46.9%, with CapEx ratio at 14.2% and a full‑year guidance of 17‑19%.

results.title: Kenny Harjo Sell Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara
results.body: Insider Kenny Harjo disposed of his entire stake in Sarana Menara Nusantara, selling 7,861,000 shares at IDR 437 per share on 2026-09-16 for a total of IDR 3,435,257,000. The sale reduced his holding from 7,861,000 shares (0.013% ownership) to zero, representing a full divestment.

results.title: Haji Isam’s Jhonlin Group to Acquire Approximately 30% of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) via PT Jhonlin Baratama
results.body: PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) will see about 30% of its shares, equivalent to 10,000,000,500 shares, transferred to PT Jhonlin Baratama, a part of Jhonlin Group owned by Haji Isam, following a conditional share purchase agreement signed on 16 September 2026. The sellers, founder Low Tuck Kwong and his daughter Elaine Low, currently hold 13.42 billion shares (40.25%) and 7.33 billion shares (22%) respectively, together controlling roughly 62.25% of BYAN. BYAN operates five Coal Contract of Work and holds 16 Mining Business Licenses covering more than 126,000 ha across East and South Kalimantan, with four active mining projects. The transaction marks Haji Isam’s entry into BYAN’s coal mining business and Low Tuck Kwong’s exit from the company he built.

results.title: PT Jhonlin Baratama to acquire 30% of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) in conditional share purchase agreement
results.body: PT Jhonlin Baratama signed a conditional share purchase agreement on 16 September 2026 to acquire 10,000,000,500 shares, representing about 30% of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN), from Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low. The transaction is subject to the fulfillment of several pre‑closing conditions and will give Jhonlin Baratama a significant minority stake in the coal producer. Following the announcement, BYAN shares jumped 19.96% to Rp13,825, touching the Auto Reject Top (ARA), while Moody's Ratings lowered BYAN’s outlook to negative amid uncertainty over RKAB approvals for its subsidiaries PT Tiwa Abadi, PT Tanur Jaya and PT Fajar Sakti Prima. In the first half of 2026, BYAN reported revenue of US$1.74 billion, net profit of US$410.26 million and coal production of 32.9 million tons, up 18.8% year‑on‑year.

results.title: Eko Santoso Hadiprodjo sell Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara
results.body: Insider Eko Santoso Hadiprodjo sold 39,673,000 Sarana Menara Nusantara shares at IDR 437 per share on 2026-09-16, generating proceeds of IDR 17,337,101,000. The sale reduced his holding from 43,670,000 shares (0.074% of the company) to 3,997,000 shares (0.007%). The transaction is recorded as a divestment.

results.title: PT Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati Tbk (MBSS) appoints Sugeng Pangraksa as President Director and Rudy Heriyanto Adi Nugroho as President Commissioner following RUPSLB
results.body: PT Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati Tbk (MBSS) appointed Sugeng Pangraksa as President Director and Rudy Heriyanto Adi Nugroho as President Commissioner following a special shareholders meeting (RUPSLB) on 17 September 2026. The RUPSLB, attended by shareholders representing 1,455 billion shares (83.18% of voting rights), also installed directors Meita Liliasari, Hessa Afigthyven and Dyan Puspita Sari Dachi, and commissioners Rina Yohana, Rico Rustombi and Aryo Wibisono. The board reshuffle follows the transfer of the controlling stake from PT Galley Adhika Arnawama, which sold 1,443,766,800 shares (≈ 82.5% of MBSS capital) to PT Wibowo Group Capital through a crossing transaction on the Bursa Efek Indonesia on 31 July 2026, making Wibowo Group Capital the new controlling shareholder. The newly appointed board will serve a five‑year term ending with the next ordinary shareholders meeting expected in 2031.

results.title: PT Petrosea Tbk (PTRO) profit jumps 902.5% in the first half of 2026
results.body: PT Petrosea Tbk (PTRO) posted a net profit of US$10.78 million (approximately Rp192.86 billion) for the first half of 2026, a 902.5% increase from US$1.07 million (Rp18.06 billion) a year earlier. Revenue rose 59.6% to US$543.98 million (Rp9.72 trillion), driven mainly by the mining segment, which generated US$300.43 million, up from US$164.71 million in the same period of 2025. Direct costs increased 69.8% to US$496.96 million, causing gross profit to fall 2.6% to US$47.03 million, while net profit was bolstered by a US$15.03 million gain in other income, a US$43.73 million foreign‑exchange gain, and US$7.62 million profit from discontinued operations. The earnings underscore Petrosea’s role as an affiliate of the Prajogo Pangestu conglomerate and reflect strong performance in its mining and offshore oil‑and‑gas EPCI businesses.

results.title: Tunggal Jaya Investama Buys Shares of Impack Pratama Industri
results.body: Tunggal Jaya Investama increased its stake in Impack Pratama Industri (IMPC.JK) by 3.35 million shares, paying a total of IDR 5,519,300,000 at an average price of about IDR 1,648 per share. The purchase raised its holding to 21,096,067,194 shares, representing 38.42% of the company, unchanged from the prior reporting period. The acquisition, recorded on September 15 and 17, is classified as an investment. The transaction follows a series of insider purchases at IMPC over the past six months, including multiple sizable buys by other insiders, indicating a continued pattern of accumulation among major shareholders.

results.title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia Sells Shares of Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera
results.body: On September 18, Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sold a total of 611,331,200 shares of Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera at an aggregate value of IDR 571,322,950,000, equivalent to an average price of about IDR 935 per share. The transaction reduced its holding from 3,956,944,700 shares (16.62% of the company) to 3,345,613,500 shares (14.06%), a decline of roughly 2.6 percentage points. This sale, executed for a pre‑termination purpose, follows a sustained divestment trend in which the institution has cut its stake from over 45% in early July to the current 14% through a series of large sell‑offs.

results.title: Dozens of Indonesian stocks removed from FTSE Russell indices as the IHSG slides 0.33%
results.body: The article reports that FTSE Russell removed 29 Indonesian stocks from all its indices, with several others downgraded from Mid‑Cap to Small‑Cap or from Small‑Cap to Micro‑Cap, effective after the close on 18 September 2026. On the same day the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 6,441.16 points, down 0.33% (‑21.27 points) after briefly reaching a session high of 6,521. The decline was linked to the latest APBN 2026 data showing a cumulative deficit of Rp240.1 trillion through August 2026 and to external sentiment from central‑bank rate hikes, including the Bank of Japan’s move to its highest level in 31 years. Sector performance was mixed, with industrial and property indices falling 1.64% and 1.44% respectively, while the technology sector posted a modest 0.27% gain, and total market turnover rose 38.39% to Rp19.25 trillion from the previous session. Regional emerging‑market indices showed mixed moves, led by South Korea’s KOSPI up 2.66% and Taiwan’s TWSE up 1.93%, while the Philippines’ PCOMP fell 1.72% and Malaysia’s FBMKLCI slipped 0.55%.

results.title: Finance Ministry Yet to Receive Kopdes Debt Invoice from Himbara, Delaying PT Agrinas Pangan Nusantara Repayment
results.body: The Ministry of Finance has not yet received the invoice for the Kopdes (village cooperative) debt, which stalls the repayment of loans extended by PT Agrinas Pangan Nusantara to Himbara. Each Kopdes unit was financed with a maximum loan of Rp3 billion, and the government will repay the loan in six‑year installments under PMK No. 15/2026 after an invoice is submitted. The ministry has allocated a budget of Rp240 trillion for the program, while PT Agrinas reports that Rp106 trillion of its budget has already been absorbed across 24,191 fully built Kopdes units. As of 17 September 2026 only three of the 24,675 units have completed verification and validation, and Kemenkop aims to finish verification of 17,280 units by 18 September 2026.

results.title: Nextier Datamate Center Sell Shares of Panca Anugrah Wisesa
results.body: Nextier Datamate Center sold 7,000,000 shares of Panca Anugrah Wisesa at IDR 10,000 per share, amounting to IDR 70,000,000,000, and lowered its stake to 1,194,500,000 shares (62.71%) from 1,201,500,000 shares (63.07%). The disposal continues a pattern of regular sell‑offs by the insider since July, during which more than 200 million shares have been sold, reducing its ownership from roughly 79% to just under 63%.

results.title: Ubs Ag Ldn Branch A/C Client Sell Shares of Charoen Pokphand Indonesia
results.body: UBS AG London Branch A/C Client sold 1,192,600 Charoen Pokphand Indonesia shares at IDR 3,111 per share on 2026-09-15, generating proceeds of IDR 3,710,178,600. The transaction reduced the holder’s stake from 6.010% (984,998,447 shares) to 6.000% (983,805,847 shares). UBS stated the sale was executed to hedge client derivative trading activities.

results.title: Royal FrieslandCampina N.V. Announces It Will Become Controlling Shareholder of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry Tbk (ULTJ)
results.body: Royal FrieslandCampina N.V. agreed to acquire a controlling stake in PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry Tbk (ULTJ) as part of a strategic partnership announced on 18 September 2026. The deal, pending shareholder and regulator approvals, will keep Ultrajaya listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange with its management and operations unchanged, trigger a mandatory tender offer for minority shareholders, and bring Frisian Flag Indonesia into the Ultrajaya Group while the Prawirawidjaja family retains a significant shareholding and the President Director role.

results.title: Sentra Amanah Ventura Sell Shares of Logisticsplus International
results.body: Sentra Amanah Ventura sold a total of 2,134,200 shares of Logisticsplus International on Sep 9, 2026 at an average price of IDR 61.73 per share, generating proceeds of IDR 131,700,400. The transaction reduced its holding from 617,503,200 to 615,369,000 shares, lowering its ownership from 56.140% to 55.940%. The sale is part of a rapid reduction of the insider’s stake, following disposals of 59,618,000 shares on Sep 8 and 46,356,700 shares on Sep 9 that brought its ownership down from 67.13% to 57.47% over two days. The purpose stated is to decrease its shareholding while maintaining majority control.

results.title: Edwin Soeryadjaya buy Shares of Saratoga Investama Sedaya
results.body: Edwin Soeryadjaya purchased an additional 1,240,000 Saratoga Investama Sedaya shares at IDR 1,771 per share, costing IDR 2,196,040,000, and raised his stake to 35.944% of the company from 35.935%. The buy adds to a series of purchases this month, bringing his cumulative acquisition since early September to roughly 8.26 million shares and reinforcing his position as the largest insider shareholder.

results.title: PT Ultra Jaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (ULTJ) to acquire PT Frisian Flag Indonesia via a rights issue, shares rise 10.5%
results.body: PT Ultra Jaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (ULTJ) announced a rights issue of 7.88 billion new shares at IDR 2,150 each to fund the purchase of 100 % of PT Frisian Flag Indonesia for IDR 14.57 trillion. The transaction represents 178.24 % of ULTJ’s equity as of 31 July 2026, requires shareholder approval at the extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 27 October 2026, and may dilute non‑participating shareholders by up to 43.11 %. Following the announcement, ULTJ’s shares opened 10.53 % higher at IDR 2,100, and FrieslandCampina International Holding B.V., the parent of Frisian Flag, will become the new controlling shareholder of ULTJ. PT Frisian Flag Indonesia reported 7‑month 2026 revenue of IDR 7.79 trillion and net profit of IDR 439.5 billion (NPM 5.6 %), while ULTJ posted revenue of IDR 6.42 trillion and net profit of IDR 1.22 trillion (NPM 19 %); management projects the combined group’s NPM to rise to 15.65 % and ROE to 12.64 % by 2031.

results.title: PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) reaches Auto Reject Atas (ARA) at Rp13,825, outpacing transaction volumes of PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) and PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR)
results.body: On 18 September 2026, PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) surged 19.96% to Rp13,825 per share, hitting the Auto Reject Atas (ARA) level with a trade volume of 10.34 million shares valued at Rp142 billion, surpassing the transaction volumes of PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) and PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR). Earlier, on 16 September 2026, PT Jhonlin Baratama, acting for Haji Isam, signed a conditional share purchase agreement with BYAN’s controlling shareholders Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low to acquire 10,000,000,500 BYAN shares, representing roughly 30% of the outstanding equity and potentially granting majority control. At that time BYAN’s valuation metrics were a price‑to‑book ratio of 10.47×, a price‑to‑earnings ratio of 31×, and a market capitalisation of Rp460.83 trillion. For the first half of 2026, BYAN reported a 17% year‑on‑year net‑profit increase to US$410.25 million (Rp7 trillion) on revenue of US$1.74 billion (Rp31 trillion), while total assets rose to US$3.78 billion and equity declined to US$2.58 billion.
